plan: A pot-bellied brewer who charges with his belly and knocks enemies away with his barrel.
aSurveiller: His E (Body Slam). He charges and knocks you up, then his R can send you flying towards his team.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: his charge (E) stops on the first one hit.
Keep an escape spell for his R: it can knock you towards his allies.
His W reduces the damage he takes: avoid long trades.
forces: His R can isolate a target.
faiblesses: His R is hard to land well.
Low damage when he plays tank.
Easy to kite if his charge misses.

sorts.P: Heals when he casts a spell.

momentFort: Strong from the start, dangerous from level 6.
